standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Algebra, Lemmas algebra-lemma-integral-no-inclusion (tag 00GS) and algebra-lemma-integral-going-up (tag 00GT); More on Algebra, Lemma more-algebra-lemma-number-of-branches-1 (tag 0C1R)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first two turn the fibre over x into maximal ideals of the integral closure and the third supplies the branch formulas.

core_obligations: Note that the hypothesis on quasi-compact opens is exactly what makes the normalization defined, and identify the stalk A' of nu_*O_{X^nu} at x as the integral closure of A = O_{X,x} in the total ring of fractions of A_red (proof lines 8588-8594).

Use integrality of nu to see that the points of X^nu lying over x correspond to the primes of A' over the maximal ideal m, which by integrality are exactly the maximal ideals of A' (proof lines 8595-8601).
Conclude both count formulas from the algebraic counterpart of the lemma (proof lines 8602-8604).
proof_roadmap: Use the hypothesis to have the normalization available.
Identify the stalk of the normalization at x as an integral closure.
Translate the fibre over x into maximal ideals of that closure.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the number of branches of X at x with the number of inverse images of x in the normalization, and the number of geometric branches with the sum of the separable degrees of the residue field extensions over those inverse images. The proof notes that the assumption that every quasi-compact open has finitely many irreducible components is exactly what makes the normalization defined, identifies the stalk of the pushforward of the structure sheaf as the integral closure of the local ring in the total ring of fractions of its reduction, and observes that because the normalization is integral, the points lying over x correspond to the maximal ideals of that integral closure (proof lines 8588-8601). The result is then read off from the algebraic counterpart of the branch count (proof lines 8602-8604). H2: the translation between the fibre of the normalization and the maximal ideals of the integral closure is the substance.
